text: They raised my limit by two thousand dollars and sent a card letting me know it arrived. It was the only invitation I've gotten this year, so yes, I'm going.
name: Rico Espinoza

text: They told me the thing costs less if you don't count the part where the bill is higher. So I stopped counting the bill, and the thing is cheap now, and oddly my account is still not.
name: Latasha Boone

text: I did not spend two years being told I was dead just for the world to realize I was alive and then not give me a parade.
name: Gerald Twine
